definition_notes: UChicago's CDS B1 grand total (UG + graduate/professional, full- and part-time). The CDS runs ~14% below both IPEDS (18,339 for Fall 2023) and UChicago's own institutional headline count. Evidence: UChicago Institutional Analysis 'Students' page (opened, https://data.uchicago.edu/data-students/, all figures Fall 2025) shows grand total 19,140 = undergraduates 7,496 + graduate students 11,236 + non-degree and other 408, whereas the Fall 2025 CDS (CDS 2025-26, opened) reports UG 7,453 + graduate 8,953 = 16,406. So UG agrees but the CDS graduate count is ~2,300 below the university's own graduate count and excludes the ~400 non-degree/other. The CDS does not explain the difference; a plausible cause (inference, not documented) is that the CDS counts only graduate students enrolled in credit courses and leaves out students registered without coursework (e.g. dissertation/continuing status).
caveats: Gap vs IPEDS -14.0% (>5%): definitional, concentrated in graduate students (see definition_notes). Decide whether to use the CDS (15.8K/16.2K) or an IPEDS-type total (18.3K for Fall 2023).

CDS 2023-24 'Total all students' row (6,647 men / 6,076 women) is a full-time-only figure (4,003+2,644 and 3,485+2,591), not all students: use the printed GRAND TOTAL 15,763 (= UG 7,489 + graduate 8,274), which reconciles to the UG and graduate rows.

Source PDFs were fetched from the wpmucdn CDN URLs that the official Institutional Analysis CDS page (https://data.uchicago.edu/common-data-set/) links as data.uchicago.edu/files/...; the first curl attempts for 2024-25 and 2022-23 hit 'connection reset by peer' and succeeded on a single retry.
